Plot an Indicator Species Analysis

Source: R/indicator_species.r
plot.ecodive_indicator_species.Rd

The features found by indicator_species() (reject): their index as bars, or their groups' mean abundances as a heatmap.

Usage

# S3 method for class 'ecodive_indicator_species'
plot(x, type = c("bar", "heatmap"), n_features = 30, ...)

Arguments

x

The result of indicator_species().

type

'bar' (the default): one horizontal bar per feature, its length the index (stat), grouped and coloured by combination, the largest first within each. 'heatmap': the features (rows) by the groups (columns), each tile shaded by the group's mean abundance as a proportion of the feature's largest group mean, with the groups of the feature's combination outlined.

n_features

How many features to show, those with the largest (absolute) index. Default: 30.

...

Passed on to graphics::plot.default(), such as main, xlab or sub.

Value

x, invisibly.

Examples

    set.seed(1)
    grp <- rep(c('a', 'b', 'c'), c(6, 8, 10))
    x <- matrix(rpois(24 * 6, 2), 24, 6, dimnames = list(NULL, paste0('f', 1:6)))
    x[grp != 'a', 1:2] <- 0
    x[grp == 'a', 3] <- 0
    res <- indicator_species(x, grp, p_adjust = 'none', cpus = 1)
    plot(res)

    plot(res, 'heatmap')
